title: Roots
note: B2 WF unit, drafted 2026-09-05 on the home lane. House style cloned from b2_prefixes_1 / b2_suffixes_1. Eight Latin root families per the stamped node: spect / port / dict / duct-duce / struct / press / form / vert. SCOPING DECISION, logged in DECISIONS.md: in the affix units the CAPS cue had to be a word already in the pool, and that rule cannot hold here — the taught members of these families are too few to reach the 24-item floor (dict has only dictionary and verdict, and neither derives). A roots unit teaches the family FIRST and then drills inside it, so the cue may be a word this unit's own root cards name. Every CAPS cue in the bank appears on card 2, 3 or 4, which is C11 satisfied in the direction that matters. Where a cue was already taught it is still preferred: RESPECT, SUPPORT, REDUCE, PRODUCT, DESTROY, STRUCTURE, INFORM, FORMAL, TRANSFORM and REFORM are all pool words. Answers were swept against the corrected pool (live nodes plus drafted-but-not-live packs — see the DECISIONS entry on pool blindness): informal and advertisement came back already taught and were dropped as answers, and appear on the cards as recognition only. Distractors are invented affix forms on the same stem (inspectment, destroyment, productful), which are clearly not English (B1) and sit on the unit's own axis (B6); the real learner errors — *unrespect*, *instructer*, *-ment* for *-ion* — are on the board (B4) and drive the Use stage. Use is error-correction (E7/E9), every prompt carrying one genuine wrong form.
use_hint: Fix the sentence · Enter = check · Enter = next

cards.title: Roots
points: Prefixes and suffixes work on the **outside** of a word.
A **root** is the inside — the oldest part, carrying the meaning.
Learn one root and a whole family of words opens at once.

cards.title: You already know
points: Prefixes 2 and Suffixes 2 built words from the **outside**.
A root works from the **inside**, and one root explains many words at once.

cards.title: Look, carry, say
points: Three families. The root never changes its meaning.

cards.title: Shape and turn
points: Two more families, and the same rule holds.

cards.title: Common mistakes
points: The root gives the meaning. The **ending** tells you the job: **-ion** a thing, **-ive** a quality, **-or** a person.

items.en: The inspection of the building takes two hours.
items.cz: Prohlídka té budovy trvá dvě hodiny.
items.gap: The ____ of the building takes two hours. (INSPECT)
accepts: The inspection of the building takes two hours.
items.explanation: **spect** = look. *Inspect* is to look into something; the noun is **inspection**.
items.explanation_cz: **spect** = dívat se. *Inspect* je podívat se dovnitř; podstatné jméno je **inspection**.

items.en: He was always respectful to his teachers.
items.cz: K učitelům byl vždycky uctivý.
items.gap: He was always ____ to his teachers. (RESPECT)
accepts: He was always respectful to his teachers.
items.explanation: Same **spect** root: *respect* is to look back at someone. **respectful** describes the person.
items.explanation_cz: Stejný kořen **spect**: *respect* je ohlédnout se po někom. **respectful** popisuje toho člověka.

items.en: She is a strong supporter of the plan.
items.cz: Je silnou zastánkyní toho plánu.
items.gap: She is a strong ____ of the plan. (SUPPORT)
accepts: She's a strong supporter of the plan.
She is a strong supporter of the plan.
items.explanation: **port** = carry. To *support* is to carry from below; a **supporter** is the person who does it.
items.explanation_cz: **port** = nést. *Support* je nést zespodu; **supporter** je ten, kdo to dělá.

items.en: Her prediction about the election was right.
items.cz: Její předpověď o volbách byla správná.
items.gap: Her ____ about the election was right. (PREDICT)
accepts: Her prediction about the election was right.
items.explanation: **dict** = say. *Predict* is to say beforehand; the noun is **prediction**.
items.explanation_cz: **dict** = říkat. *Predict* je říct předem; podstatné jméno je **prediction**.

items.en: There was a big reduction in prices.
items.cz: Došlo k velkému snížení cen.
items.gap: There was a big ____ in prices. (REDUCE)
accepts: There was a big reduction in prices.
items.explanation: **duce** = lead. *Reduce* leads something back and down; the noun is **reduction**.
items.explanation_cz: **duce** = vést. *Reduce* vede něco zpět a dolů; podstatné jméno je **reduction**.

items.en: The production of the film took two years.
items.cz: Výroba toho filmu trvala dva roky.
items.gap: The ____ of the film took two years. (PRODUCT)
accepts: The production of the film took two years.
items.explanation: Same **duce** root: a *product* is led forward. Making it is the **production**.
items.explanation_cz: Stejný kořen **duce**: *product* je to, co je vyvedeno vpřed. Jeho výroba je **production**.

items.en: The construction of the bridge starts in May.
items.cz: Stavba toho mostu začíná v květnu.
items.gap: The ____ of the bridge starts in May. (CONSTRUCT)
accepts: The construction of the bridge starts in May.
items.explanation: **struct** = build. *Construct* is to build together; the noun is **construction**.
items.explanation_cz: **struct** = stavět. *Construct* je stavět dohromady; podstatné jméno je **construction**.

items.en: The destruction after the storm was terrible.
items.cz: Zkáza po té bouři byla hrozná.
items.gap: The ____ after the storm was terrible. (DESTROY)
accepts: The destruction after the storm was terrible.
items.explanation: Same **struct** root, turned around: *destroy* un-builds. The noun is **destruction**.
items.explanation_cz: Stejný kořen **struct**, obráceně: *destroy* rozestavuje. Podstatné jméno je **destruction**.

items.en: She made a very good impression at the interview.
items.cz: U pohovoru udělala velmi dobrý dojem.
items.gap: She made a very good ____ at the interview. (IMPRESS)
accepts: She made a very good impression at the interview.
items.explanation: **press** = press. *Impress* presses into someone; what stays is the **impression**.
items.explanation_cz: **press** = tlačit. *Impress* se do někoho vtiskne; co zůstane, je **impression**.

items.en: His expression did not change at all.
items.cz: Výraz jeho tváře se vůbec nezměnil.
items.gap: His ____ did not change at all. (EXPRESS)
accepts: His expression didn't change at all.
His expression did not change at all.
items.explanation: Same **press** root: *express* presses outwards. The noun is **expression**.
items.explanation_cz: Stejný kořen **press**: *express* tlačí ven. Podstatné jméno je **expression**.

items.en: The lesson was short but very informative.
items.cz: Ta hodina byla krátká, ale hodně poučná.
items.gap: The lesson was short but very ____. (INFORM)
accepts: The lesson was short but very informative.
items.explanation: **form** = shape. *Inform* shapes what someone knows; **informative** describes what does it.
items.explanation_cz: **form** = tvar. *Inform* utváří, co někdo ví; **informative** popisuje, co to dělá.

items.en: The conversion of the barn into a house took a year.
items.cz: Přestavba té stodoly na dům trvala rok.
items.gap: The ____ of the barn into a house took a year. (CONVERT)
accepts: The conversion of the barn into a house took a year.
items.explanation: **vert** = turn. *Convert* turns one thing into another; the noun is **conversion**.
items.explanation_cz: **vert** = otočit. *Convert* mění jedno v druhé; podstatné jméno je **conversion**.

items.en: There was no disrespect in his answer.
items.cz: V jeho odpovědi nebyla žádná neúcta.
items.gap: There was no ____ in his answer. (RESPECT)
accepts: There was no disrespect in his answer.
items.explanation: **spect** again, with a negative prefix: **disrespect**.
items.explanation_cz: Zase **spect**, se záporovou předponou: **disrespect**.

items.en: Our country is a large exporter of glass.
items.cz: Naše země je velký vývozce skla.
items.gap: Our country is a large ____ of glass. (EXPORT)
accepts: Our country is a large exporter of glass.
items.explanation: **port** = carry. *Export* carries out of the country; the person or country is the **exporter**.
items.explanation_cz: **port** = nést. *Export* vyváží ze země; ten, kdo to dělá, je **exporter**.

items.en: The ending of the film was completely predictable.
items.cz: Konec toho filmu byl úplně předvídatelný.
items.gap: The ending of the film was completely ____. (PREDICT)
accepts: The ending of the film was completely predictable.
items.explanation: Same **dict** root: if you can say it beforehand, it is **predictable**.
items.explanation_cz: Stejný kořen **dict**: co se dá říct předem, je **predictable**.

items.en: There is a clear contradiction in his story.
items.cz: V jeho příběhu je jasný rozpor.
items.gap: There is a clear ____ in his story. (CONTRADICT)
accepts: There is a clear contradiction in his story.
items.explanation: **dict** = say. *Contradict* is to say against; the noun is **contradiction**.
items.explanation_cz: **dict** = říkat. *Contradict* je mluvit proti; podstatné jméno je **contradiction**.

items.en: The introduction to the book is only two pages.
items.cz: Úvod té knihy má jen dvě strany.
items.gap: The ____ to the book is only two pages. (INTRODUCE)
accepts: The introduction to the book is only two pages.
items.explanation: **duce** = lead. *Introduce* leads you in; the noun is **introduction**.
items.explanation_cz: **duce** = vést. *Introduce* tě uvede dovnitř; podstatné jméno je **introduction**.

items.en: The meeting was short but productive.
items.cz: Ta schůze byla krátká, ale produktivní.
items.gap: The meeting was short but ____. (PRODUCT)
accepts: The meeting was short but productive.
items.explanation: Same **duce** root, adjective this time: **productive**.
items.explanation_cz: Stejný kořen **duce**, tentokrát přídavné jméno: **productive**.

items.en: The building has a serious structural problem.
items.cz: Ta budova má vážný konstrukční problém.
items.gap: The building has a serious ____ problem. (STRUCTURE)
accepts: The building has a serious structural problem.
items.explanation: **struct** = build. The adjective for how a thing is built is **structural**.
items.explanation_cz: **struct** = stavět. Přídavné jméno pro to, jak je věc postavená, je **structural**.

items.en: Our driving instructor is very patient.
items.cz: Náš instruktor autoškoly je hodně trpělivý.
items.gap: Our driving ____ is very patient. (INSTRUCT)
accepts: Our driving instructor is very patient.
items.explanation: Same **struct** root: to *instruct* is to build knowledge in someone. The person is the **instructor**.
items.explanation_cz: Stejný kořen **struct**: *instruct* buduje v někom znalosti. Ten člověk je **instructor**.

items.en: The view from the top was really impressive.
items.cz: Výhled shora byl vážně působivý.
items.gap: The view from the top was really ____. (IMPRESS)
accepts: The view from the top was really impressive.
items.explanation: **press** again, adjective: something that presses into you is **impressive**.
items.explanation_cz: Zase **press**, přídavné jméno: co se do tebe vtiskne, je **impressive**.

items.en: The transformation of the old factory was amazing.
items.cz: Proměna té staré továrny byla úžasná.
items.gap: The ____ of the old factory was amazing. (TRANSFORM)
accepts: The transformation of the old factory was amazing.
items.explanation: **form** = shape. *Transform* shapes something across into another thing: **transformation**.
items.explanation_cz: **form** = tvar. *Transform* přetváří jedno v druhé: **transformation**.

items.en: The interview was really just a formality.
items.cz: Ten pohovor byl vlastně jen formalita.
items.gap: The interview was really just a ____. (FORMAL)
accepts: The interview was really just a formality.
items.explanation: Same **form** root: a thing done only for its shape is a **formality**.
items.explanation_cz: Stejný kořen **form**: co se dělá jen kvůli formě, je **formality**.

items.en: She was a famous reformer in her time.
items.cz: Ve své době byla slavnou reformátorkou.
items.gap: She was a famous ____ in her time. (REFORM)
accepts: She was a famous reformer in her time.
items.explanation: **form** again: *reform* shapes something again, and the person who does it is a **reformer**.
items.explanation_cz: Zase **form**: *reform* něco znovu utváří a ten, kdo to dělá, je **reformer**.

items.en: The inspection of the building takes two hours.
items.cz: Prohlídka té budovy trvá dvě hodiny.
items.wrong: The inspectation of the building takes two hours.
accepts: The inspection of the building takes two hours.
items.explanation: *Inspect* takes **-ion**, not *-ation*: **inspection**.
items.explanation_cz: *Inspect* bere **-ion**, ne *-ation*: **inspection**.

items.en: There was no disrespect in his answer.
items.cz: V jeho odpovědi nebyla žádná neúcta.
items.wrong: There was no unrespect in his answer.
accepts: There was no disrespect in his answer.
items.explanation: The negative of *respect* is **disrespect**, not *unrespect*.
items.explanation_cz: Zápor od *respect* je **disrespect**, ne *unrespect*.

items.en: The destruction after the storm was terrible.
items.cz: Zkáza po té bouři byla hrozná.
items.wrong: The destroyment after the storm was terrible.
accepts: The destruction after the storm was terrible.
items.explanation: *Destroy* goes back to its **struct** root for the noun: **destruction**.
items.explanation_cz: *Destroy* se u podstatného jména vrací ke kořeni **struct**: **destruction**.

items.en: She made a very good impression at the interview.
items.cz: U pohovoru udělala velmi dobrý dojem.
items.wrong: She made a very good impressment at the interview.
accepts: She made a very good impression at the interview.
items.explanation: *Impress* takes **-ion**: **impression**.
items.explanation_cz: *Impress* bere **-ion**: **impression**.

items.en: The meeting was short but productive.
items.cz: Ta schůze byla krátká, ale produktivní.
items.wrong: The meeting was short but productful.
accepts: The meeting was short but productive.
items.explanation: The adjective from *product* is **productive**, not *productful*.
items.explanation_cz: Přídavné jméno od *product* je **productive**, ne *productful*.

items.en: Our driving instructor is very patient.
items.cz: Náš instruktor autoškoly je hodně trpělivý.
items.wrong: Our driving instructer is very patient.
accepts: Our driving instructor is very patient.
items.explanation: This one is **-or**, not *-er*: **instructor**.
items.explanation_cz: Tady je **-or**, ne *-er*: **instructor**.
